question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'about.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the prepositions given in the options:

 
 
 

 Preposition
 Usage
 
 
 
 

 about
 used to indicate movement within a particular area; to indicate the subject of concern
 
 

 in
 used to denote when something is inside another thing; to denote unspecified times, months, years, and seasons
 
 

 of
 used to indicate relating to, belonging to; to indicate reference; to specify the number or an amount
 
 

 within
 to indicate before a particular period of time or during a particular period of time; to denote inside the range or limits of something
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the author was wondering who would walk within the particular area of the empty road at late night in the rain.
 
• Here the preposition **'about'** indicates movement in the particular empty road.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "about."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Complete passage:__ *The rain was coming down relentlessly. Even __(1) with__ a fast windscreen wiper, the road was __(2) hardly__ visible in the dark. Away from the noisy station we had just left, I __(3) noticed__ the empty roads. Indeed, who would be walking __(4) about__ at such a late hour in the pouring rain? Shekhar was __(5) a__ steady driver as a rule, but we __(6) were__ both worried by now and he was already driving __(7) extremely__ fast. The road conditions were __(8) far__ from good. It was a bad ride, but we barely noticed it as we were so __(9) tense__. The only thing I was worried about was finding my daughter, a young, __(10) unaccompanied__ girl alone on the streets at this hour.*
